controls.title: Representative hardware matrix
blockers: Repeatable coverage across representative Lenovo, Dell, HP, Acer, AMD, Intel, NVIDIA, network, audio, storage, dock, and display combinations is not established.

controls.title: Certified, Compatible, and Experimental support levels
blockers: Tier semantics are enforced in Arach-HWD, but no production device set has completed publication under those levels.

controls.title: Stable, testing, and development channels
blockers: Promotion, demotion, retention, rollback, and cross-channel upgrade policies are not operationally qualified.

controls.title: Repository mirrors
blockers: Signed mirror publication, consistency, failover, stale-mirror rejection, and compromise recovery are not established.

controls.title: Release rollback drills
blockers: Bad package, bad catalog, bad kernel, bad bootloader, and interrupted-release rollback drills are incomplete.

controls.title: Advisories and release notes
blockers: Canonical advisory, compatibility-change, migration, known-issue, and release-note publication workflows are not operational.

controls.title: Sustained soak testing
blockers: Long-duration desktop, suspend-cycle, network, storage, audio, thermal, and update soak runs are not established.
